Hi Anna —

Thanks again for a great evaluation kickoff earlier this week. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (Redwood-MAP-v3.pdf) that aligns the eval milestones with procurement and legal checkpoints so we can lock a target start date. High level proposed timeline:

- 6/09: MAP shared (this email)
- 6/10–6/12: Legal & SOW review
- 6/14: Final go/no-go decision from Greenline execs
- 6/15–6/22: Esign & procurement (DocuSign + PO)
- Target day-one: 7/05 (if signatures complete by 6/22)

Couple of asks from our side: can legal confirm the SOW redline window and can procurement confirm any PO lead time restrictions? I also attached a simple signer matrix (Greenline-Signers.xlsx) so we can surface signers and their availability.

If this timeline works we can start a short cadence of daily check-ins next week to keep momentum.

Best,
